playbook.note: Clear majority rendering (~52 occurrences); a few strings keep 'playbook' in English.

run.note: Noun. Verb: 'ejecutar' ('ejecutar un libro de jugadas'). Existing es.json is split between 'ejecución' (~40) and the mistranslation 'carrera' (~42, meaning 'race'); use 'ejecución' — 'carrera' is an MT artifact, not a deliberate choice.

finish a run.note: Existing 'Finaliza la carrera' inherits the 'carrera' mistranslation; use 'ejecución'.

checklist.note: Majority rendering; 'lista de comprobación' appears sporadically.

action.note: Run actions: 'acciones de ejecución'; task actions: 'acciones de la tarea' per existing strings.

due date.note: Existing rendering; 'No due date': 'Sin fecha de vencimiento'.

timeline.note: Majority rendering; 'línea de tiempo' appears once.

stakeholder.note: No repo signal; standard business-Spanish rendering. Plural: 'partes interesadas'.

assignee.note: Existing 'Cesionario' is a legal-domain mistranslation; other strings use 'los asignados'. Prefer 'persona asignada'.

run channel.note: Existing rendering ('Se enviará una solicitud… al canal de ejecución').

broadcast.note: Existing: 'Transmitir la actualización a los canales seleccionados'.

run summary.note: Existing template string uses 'resumen de ejecución'.
